correctness.rationale: Strictly positive payoff gaps ensure 0<A(x)<B(x) on [0,1]. The invariant logit(n)−logit(m)=K reduces the flow to x in (0,1), u in R with E_K(u) strictly increasing onto (0,1), unique equilibrium x*=1/(1+θ), E_K(u*)=A(x*)/B(x*). The proper separable H_K has dH/dt=Δ(x−x*)²/[B(x)B(x*)], confirmed by direct rational differentiation (A′B−AB′=d0 e1−e0 d1). For Δ<0 LaSalle gives globally selected leaf equilibrium; Δ=0 regular proper one-well levels are periodic; Δ>0 bounded energy would give invariant non-equilibrium compact omega set contradiction, so distance to boundary tends zero. Statement only interior, symmetric equal feedback. Numerical integrations are illustrations.
